notes: Leveling stage 4 (game/stat_growth.h): major story steps (data/critpath.json ids) that raise stats, next to quest_xp.json. Paid once per game when the step is first seen done: each companion walking with the Avatar then (Follow, alive, on his map) gets 'companions' points in their main stat; the Avatar gets 'avatar' points (0: nothing; he has the chosen point of every level).
main_stat: by companion id; one not listed goes by class (fighter STR, caster INT, hybrid: the highest of its level-1 stats).
Old games: steps already done when stage 4 first sees the game never pay.
